# This directory holds the compiled backend sidecar binaries.
# Files in here are generated by `npm run build:sidecar` (Windows) or `npm run build:sidecar:linux` (Linux) and should NOT be committed.
# The naming convention follows Tauri's target-triple format:
#   noctune-backend-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe  (Windows x64)
#   noctune-backend-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu     (Linux x64)
#   noctune-backend-x86_64-apple-darwin          (macOS x64)
#   noctune-backend-aarch64-apple-darwin          (macOS ARM)
